caption:
Taylor has 175 homes in the pipeline at North Village. Local builder EVK Homes broke ground November 24 near North Drive and Tribute Boulevard. The 40-acre project also includes 10 acres planned for commercial use.

The timing matters for Taylor’s housing market. The full buildout is expected to take about 15 years. For buyers tracking new construction in eastern Williamson County, the next useful number is how many homes the first phase will bring to market.
